name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering system and kitchen display
promotionalText: Accept pre-orders, don’t let orders exceed the kitchen’s load, and trade as normal even when the network drops. The ordering app built for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app built for food trucks: your team relies on it to carry every service.

Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm the orders the kitchen can make, then mark them ready for collection and collected.

[Don’t promise a time you can’t deliver]
Set how much the kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue of orders matches the kitchen’s capacity.

[Walk-up orders in front of the truck]
Add walk-up orders to the same screen as pre-orders, and the kitchen just follows one queue to send out food.

[A single screen just for the kitchen]
The kitchen display system lists the orders to make now, to make next and ready for collection, and gives a reminder when an order needs to be started.

[Print order tickets]
Connect the kitchen’s receipt printer via Bluetooth or local area network and order tickets print automatically.

[Trade as normal even offline]
With offline protection on, if the connection drops, pre-ordering pauses so nobody places an order you can’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync automatically when the connection is back.

[Designed for life on the truck]
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen always on during trading, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

[Plan your week]
Set up events and locations just once and you can take orders for every event.

HatchGrab is designed for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
